description: The plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates the absolute mean values of hidden states across different network layers for three distinct conditions: “hidden state mean before gate,” “hidden state mean after gate,” and “hidden state mean of baseline.” The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating a linear scale representing the depth of the model’s layers. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4, also on a linear scale, and quantifies the average absolute value of the hidden state activations. The dashed blue line, representing “hidden state mean before gate,” begins near 0.1 at layer 0, remains relatively flat until layer 15, then rises sharply, peaking above 4 at layer 22, with an overall average of 0.71. The dotted orange line, “hidden state mean after gate,” stays close to 0 across all layers, with a slight upward trend toward the end, averaging 0.05. The solid green line, “hidden state mean of baseline,” remains nearly flat and close to 0 throughout, averaging 0.04, indicating minimal activation magnitude compared to the gated conditions.
